component.name: KDE Dictation
component.summary: Global shortcut dictation for KDE Plasma

description.p: KDE Dictation records your microphone on a global shortcut, sends the audio to an OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text service (batch or realtime) and pastes the transcript into the focused application.
It works on Plasma Wayland and X11. Speech recognition is performed by an external service that you configure.
